text:
aina: quick idea — build a tiny gateway shim, only do header normalization + legacy-envelope unwrap. much easier to test and retire.

sam: sounds safer than a runtime-wide shim. which headers/fields are we mapping?

aina: keep it minimal: Legacy-Client-Version -> X-Client-Version, Legacy-User-ID -> X-User-ID, and unwrap body.envelope when present. no other shape changes.

maria: telemetry: shim.used boolean on traces, mapped_field.{name}.drop and mapped_field.{name}.null counters. alert if any mapped_field error rate > 0.5% over 24h.

tom: perf note: lazy parse only when header present or tenant flagged. add a 15ms transform budget and a circuit-breaker to bypass shim if latency spikes.

sam: SDKs: some customers can't set headers. ship tiny adapter snippets for each major SDK and a console tenant opt-in toggle.

jen: comms: we'll need a one-page migration playbook and an email template. recommend 30d opt-in, then 30d opt-out cohort, retire at 90d. i'll draft.

aina: implementation sketch (yaml-driven ruleset):
```
- id: lw-envelope-unwrap
  when_header: X-RW-Compat
  header_maps:
    Legacy-Client-Version: X-Client-Version
    Legacy-User-ID: X-User-ID
  unwrap_body_envelope: true
  timeout_ms: 15
  circuit_breaker: {window_ms:3000, max_latency_ms:20}
```

maria: also add shim.version tag and shim.bypass_count metric. we want a histogram of transform_latency_ms.

tom: I'll implement the circuit-breaker and perf guard. canary deploy plan?

deploy-bot: canary deployed gateway-compat v0.1 to prod-us-west (traffic: 1%). logs -> /infra/gateway/compat/2026-03-23/

aina: action items: sam -> SDK snippets; maria -> metrics + alerts; tom -> circuit-breaker + perf budget; jen -> playbook + comms. reconvene in 1 week to review canary metrics. :thumbsup:
